My name is Atiana, and I am a facilitator of Kundalini energy activation based in Dublin, Ireland. I host online sessions and events for people around the world.
KEA is not a medical service. We do not treat illness and we do not make promises about results. Please read our
We go at your pace. You can rest, skip or sit out any part of a class.
We use simple words and short steps. No special terms, no pressure.
All levels, all bodies, all backgrounds. You belong here.
What to expect in a class
You get an email with your Zoom link. Find a quiet spot with a yoga mat or a comfy rug. Wear comfortable clothes. Have water nearby.
Please join 5 minutes before the start. Doors close at the start time, and we cannot let you in later.
You lie down, listen to music and allow what arises. Please keep your camera on, with your full body visible. You can stop at any time.
There is a short quiet minute. You can ask questions. Then you get a short thank-you email.

head.ogTitle: Questions people ask – KEA by Atiana
head.ogDescription: Answers about classes, Zoom, credits, booking and cancellation and 1:1 sessions.

tokens: Short answers about classes, credits and booking. Cannot find yours? Please
No. All sessions welcome beginners. You only need to lie down, listen to the music and allow what arises.
What do I need for a class?
A device with Zoom, a quiet place, a yoga mat or comfy rug to lie on, and comfortable clothes. Wireless headphones or a speaker give good sound. Please keep your camera on.
Do I need my camera on?
Yes. Please keep your camera on and lie down so that your full body is visible from the side, from head to toes. The teacher watches each person during the session. We do not record sessions.
When do I get the Zoom link?
We send it by email right after you book. We also send a reminder 24 hours before the class.
Can I share my credits with a friend?
No. Credits belong to your account.

Yes. Cancel up to 24 hours before the class and you get your credit back. If you paid by card, you also get a credit. A free class can be cancelled any time before it starts. [OWNER: confirm "credit back" also for single paid classes]
What if I miss the 24-hour limit or do not show up?
The credit is used and we cannot refund it. If you had a real problem, write to us and we will try to help.
What if a class is cancelled by KEA?
We will email you. You get your credit back, or you can move to another class.
How is a 1:1 session different from a group class?
It is only for you and your teacher. You choose the topic and the pace. You can meet online or in person.
Yes, up to 24 hours before. Use "My bookings" or write to us.
No. Our classes are for relaxation and wellbeing only. They do not replace advice from a doctor. If you are pregnant or have a medical condition, please talk to your doctor first.
How can I contact you or leave the newsletter?
Use the Contact page or write to [CONTACT EMAIL]. Every newsletter has an unsubscribe link at the bottom.
